name: branding-tilted-business-cards-violet-and-white-on-black
title: Two floating business cards, white and violet, on a black field
whatItIs: On pure black, two cards float at angles, one white with a violet monogram and black wordmark, and one violet with the mark and name in white.
whatItMeans: Clean and modern; a colour reversal shows the identity's range simply.
techniques: Float two colourways of a card at opposing angles.
Keep the layout centred and minimal.
Add subtle grain on the coloured card.

vocabulary.definition: Objects suspended at angles without a surface.
A colour variation of the same design.
The logo in white on colour.
